nodes.list.options.[odloz].text.t: I'll put the letter aside and come back later.

nodes.list.options.[straznik].text.t: I know that seal. That's the old soldier from the Last Watchtower.

nodes.list.options.[tomasz].text.t: I know that seal. That's Tomasz's hand.

nodes.list.options.[wedrowcy].text.t: I know that seal. That's the wanderers from Głuszec.

nodes.list.text.t: A messenger in a wet cloak clutches a sealed envelope. "From the mainland. No sender's name, but I know the seal. I'm to give it to the hetman or to someone who knows what to do with it."

nodes.straznik.options.[zatrzymaj].text.t: I'm keeping the letter. Nobody needs it today.

nodes.straznik.text.t: The letter was written by a hand that once held a knife and now holds a pen clumsily. The old soldier from the Last Watchtower writes briefly: that the garrison everyone took for quiet folk has something to say too, and that if anyone on the island still wants to listen, let them.

nodes.tomasz.options.[zatrzymaj].text.t: I'm keeping the letter. Nobody needs it today.

nodes.tomasz.text.t: The letter is short, written in pencil in a crooked hand: "I'm writing because somebody has to. The people in the ravine ask whether the war will end, and I can't answer. If the hetman still has a conscience, let him read that there are people on the other side too who've had enough." There's no signature, but you know the hand.

nodes.wedrowcy.options.[zatrzymaj].text.t: I'm keeping the letter. Nobody needs it today.

nodes.wedrowcy.text.t: The letter was written by several hands, with corrections and crossings-out. They write that it's quiet in Głuszec, that rumours of war are going round, and that somebody keeps asking after "the one with the sparks". They're waiting for news, and when it's all over, there's a bench by the fire for you.

nodes.wszebor.options.[zatrzymaj].text.t: I'm keeping the letter. Nobody needs it today.

nodes.wszebor.text.t: Commander Wszebor writes in chancery style, like a man who doesn't want to offend anyone: if the addressee is still alive, he asks that the hetman be told the war has stopped being his private affair and become everyone's.

nodes.wynik_przekaz.text.t: The hetman's runner takes the letter without a word. Before you've turned away he is already reading, and something crosses his face that isn't anger.

nodes.wynik_zatrzymaj.text.t: The letter goes into your pocket. The messenger shrugs. It's all one to him, he's been paid anyway.
